newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's names gun executive as new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's names gun executive as new CEO.

text.p: Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc., the iconoclastic ice cream maker, said Thursday that Perry Odak, a former executive of the firm that makes Winchester rifles, would become its new chief executive.

Odak, who has a quarter of a century's experience with a number of manufacturers of personal products, will succeed Bob Holland, who resigned in September after less than two years as CEO, saying the job should go to someone with more marketing experience.
"We feel incredibly lucky to have found a person of Perry's calibre to lead our company at this time," co-founder and Chairman Ben Cohen said in a statement.

Odak, most recently an executive at U.S. Repeating Arms Co. (Winchester), the gun manufacturer, also held senior management positions at Dellwood Foods, Armour-Dial, and Jovan Inc. over the past 25 years.

"I am really excited about the chance to work with so fine a brand -- and company -- as Ben & Jerry's," Odak said in a statement. "There is a lot to do here and I view the tasks at hand as being great opportunities for both Ben & Jerry's and me."
Wall Street greeted the news by sending shares of Ben & Jerry's, which had been battered over the past year, up 50 cents to $11.375 in light trading on the Nasdaq market.
